Read-only view using OEM module decoding. Custom firmware may differ. Unknown or missing fields stay unknown; old values are marked stale.

B0 is the module vehicle summary, separate from raw CAN frames. Gear codes: 1=P, 2=R, 3=N, 4=D; other values are unknown and do not confirm P. Speed is the OEM raw value; its physical unit is not verified. Percent and odometer use OEM display formulas. Trunk fields are open/closed. Temperature fields use the extended OEM block. The voltage measurement point is not confirmed; it is not identified as the 12 V battery. Door/light masks show raw status bits; individual bits are not named.\n\nCAN ID identifies a message channel, not a complete signal definition. DLC is the data byte count. Hz is the average receive rate for that ID during the current capture. Age is time since the last received frame. Raw CAN IDs remain undecoded without a verified signal definition; displayed bytes are not vehicle commands.

Unknown CAN IDs are undecoded. Start reuses hardware recording and its 5-minute / size limits; stop before vehicle control or OTA. Showing bytes here does not enable raw bytes in exported logs; that choice is on the Bluetooth / Update page.
